what: ”Too much luggage, a taxi is pricey…” Press the speech-bubble button and the pickup story plays on its own, flipping scenes (about 11.4s) — the button vanishes and the title pill turns on at .3s → at 1.3s the car enters from the right edge (left 100%) to the center (50%) in .3s and stops → at 2.4s the waiting people vanish in .2s (they got in) → at 3.4s the car leaves past the left edge (−100%) over 1s → at 4.4s the first scene (station) panel slides out to the right (.5s swing) while the second scene (shop) slides in from the left .2s later → at 4.9s the car flips and returns to the center over 1s → at 7.4s the third scene (paperwork done) comes in (.5s) and at 7.9s the second one leaves in .3s → at 8.9s the car swaps to another car (the rental car) in .2s → at 9.1s the ”Replay” button turns on, and from 9.4s the rental car leaves toward the right edge over 2s. Pressing Replay brings the first scene back in .3s and the people stand up again 1.3s later in .3s. Curves are the original jQuery’s linear·swing(= sine.inOut)

options.[data-fx-part=trigger]: Speech-bubble button that starts on press (button)
options.[data-fx-part=scene]: Three stacked scene panels — in order: station, shop, end of procedure. The panel width must equal the stage width so that xPercent 100 lands outside the stage
options.[data-fx-part=car]: Passing cars (use left % with position: absolute inside the stage)
options.[data-fx-part=car-end]: (If any) Car that swaps at the end and drives away
options.[data-fx-part=title]: (If present) title pill that lights up on start
options.[data-fx-part=crowd]: (If present) waiting people who vanish when the car stops
options.[data-fx-part=replay]: (If present) Replay button that turns on when finished
options.speed: Speed multiplier, default 1 — at 2 it flows in half the length (for screens viewed often, like apps)
